advisory_text: Namaste Anita Devi. Your FarmCredit risk level is Critical. Main pressure points: Existing debt increased pressure on repayment capacity; A past default signal pushed risk higher; Loan size is high relative to what similar farms typically carry. What is helping: Keep using practices that protect income.. Next steps: match crop and irrigation to local rainfall, keep loan size close to expected income, and ask your bank/CSC about KCC, PM-KISAN, and PMFBY eligibility.
